block.botanicalmekanism.mana_lotus.descr: Uses FE to produce mana. Bind to a mana spreader with a Wand of the Forest. Mount on solid supports or cables; no soil is required.
block.botanicalmekanism.bionic_amaranthu: Uses FE to grow mystical flowers on suitable ground. Mount on solid supports or cables; no soil is required.
block.botanicalmekanism.bionic_clayconia: Uses FE to turn nearby sand into clay balls. Mount on solid supports or cables; no soil is required.
block.botanicalmekanism.bionic_agricarna: Uses FE to accelerate suitable nearby plants. Mount on solid supports or cables; no soil is required.
block.botanicalmekanism.bionic_hopperhoc: Uses FE to collect drops into adjacent inventories. Item frames filter; sneak-use a Wand to change mode. Mount on solid supports or cables; no soil is required.
block.botanicalmekanism.bionic_rannuncar: Uses FE to place dropped blocks. Matches the block two below the flower; sneak-use a Wand to change mode. Mount on solid supports or cables; no soil is required.
Uses FE to heat and accelerate nearby working furnaces. Mount on solid supports or cables; no soil is required.
Links Corporea sparks and an ME network. Powered by ME; uses one channel. Mount on solid supports or cables; no soil is required.
block.botanicalmekanism.resonance_flower: Manages a wireless mana network in this dimension. Right-click to configure its name and members. Mount on solid supports or cables; no soil is required.
block.botanicalmekanism.resonance_bud.de: Supplies or receives mana from an adjacent pool, or relays a wireless connection. Mount on solid supports or cables; no soil is required.
gui.botanicalmekanism.mode_help.0: Takes mana from an adjacent pool or machine output, keeping the reserve.
gui.botanicalmekanism.mode_help.1: Receives mana into an adjacent pool or machine input up to the target.
gui.botanicalmekanism.mode_help.2: Extends network connections; no adjacent pool is required.
gui.botanicalmekanism.select_network_fir: Select a network from the list first
gui.botanicalmekanism.no_networks: Place a Resonance Flower or ask its owner to add you
gui.botanicalmekanism.network_full: The network has no free node slots
gui.botanicalmekanism.detect_failed: Needs exactly one adjacent supported pool or mana machine
gui.botanicalmekanism.setting_failed: Setting rejected; check requirements and access
gui.botanicalmekanism.member_hint: Add an online player by name; enter an authorized name again to remove them.
gui.botanicalmekanism.bind_help: Sneak-use the Wand in the air to select Bind Mode, then sneak-use the flower and a spreader within 6 blocks.
gui.botanicalmekanism.amaranthus_ground: The bionic flower can stand on stone or cables
gui.botanicalmekanism.relay_hint: Relays extend links; no adjacent pool needed
gui.botanicalmekanism.amaranthus_hint: Needs suitable ground for mystical flowers
gui.botanicalmekanism.status.missing_poo: No supported target or mana port
description.botanicalmekanism.mechanical: Uses water and energy to craft native and bionic flowers. Reagent enters at the back; products leave on the right.
tooltip.botanicalmekanism.spark_range: Install at both ends for %s-block spark range. Keeps native dyes and augments.
description.botanicalmekanism.mana_bridg: Connects an adjacent native mana pool to chemical tubes. Select the pool face and transfer direction.
description.botanicalmekanism.mana_charg: Charges or drains a mana item using an adjacent native pool; outputs it at the selected percentage.
description.botanicalmekanism.mana_infus: Uses energy and mana to infuse materials. Insert alchemy or conjuration catalysts at the back.
description.botanicalmekanism.runic_forg: Uses energy, mana and a reagent to craft runes, retaining recipe catalysts.
description.botanicalmekanism.pure_conve: Uses energy to make livingwood, livingrock and other supported solid conversions without world effects.
description.botanicalmekanism.terra_cond: Place at the center of a complete terra platform. Uses energy and the recipe mana cost.
description.botanicalmekanism.botanical_: Uses energy and mana to brew botanical potions. Supply brew containers at the back.
description.botanicalmekanism.ore_proces: Uses energy and mana for random ores. Insert an Orechid or Orechid Ignem; Ignem needs a ceiling dimension.
description.botanicalmekanism.metamorphi: Uses energy and mana to make metamorphic stone, weighted by the local biome.
description.botanicalmekanism.elven_trad: Place beside an open native elven portal. Uses energy for trades; the portal draws mana from its own pools.
description.botanicalmekanism.mana_encha: Place beside a formed mana enchanter. Supply equipment, books, energy and mana; books remain.
gui.botanicalmekanism.machine.status.7: Native device or platform not ready
gui.botanicalmekanism.machine.status.13: Orechid Ignem needs a ceiling dimension
gui.botanicalmekanism.corporea.status.or: Use an ordinary Corporea spark on the flower
gui.botanicalmekanism.corporea.status.du: This Corporea network has another bridge

book.botanicalmekanism.intro: Bionic flowers, automated processing, sparks and item networks. Use this Lexica on a device to open its entry.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_lotus.title: Conduction Lotus
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_lotus.0: Supply FE and bind a spreader within six blocks with the Wand. Default output is 4 mana/t for 200 FE/t. An unbound, full or paused Lotus stops producing.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_lotus.cost: Each batch needs 1,000 mB water and 30,000 FE over 200 base ticks. The bottom row shows reagent, water and output. Apothecary speed/energy upgrades apply.
book.botanicalmekanism.bionic_amaranthus: Grows ordinary mystical flowers on suitable ground. Each operation uses a reserve worth 5,000 FE; colors and planting rules remain native.
Each batch needs 1,000 mB water and 16,000 FE over 160 base ticks. The bottom row shows reagent, water and output. Apothecary speed/energy upgrades apply.
Consumes sand in the world to produce one clay ball, using a reserve worth 4,000 FE. Pair with Rannuncarpus and Hopperhock for placement and collection.
Each batch needs 1,000 mB water and 16,000 FE over 160 base ticks. The bottom row shows reagent, water and output. Apothecary speed/energy upgrades apply.
book.botanicalmekanism.bionic_agricarnat: Accelerates eligible plant growth attempts. Each valid attempt costs a reserve worth 250 FE, even when growth does not occur.
Each batch needs 1,000 mB water and 16,000 FE over 160 base ticks. The bottom row shows reagent, water and output. Apothecary speed/energy upgrades apply.
book.botanicalmekanism.bionic_hopperhock: Collects drops into adjacent inventories with item-frame filters. Sneak-use the Wand to change mode. Each successful collection batch uses 1 reserved mana; no free fallback.
Each batch needs 1,000 mB water and 16,000 FE over 160 base ticks. The bottom row shows reagent, water and output. Apothecary speed/energy upgrades apply.
book.botanicalmekanism.bionic_rannuncarp: Places dropped blocks on ground matching the block two below the flower. Sneak-use the Wand to change state matching. Uses 1 mana per placement and keeps a 1-mana reserve.
Each batch needs 1,000 mB water and 16,000 FE over 160 base ticks. The bottom row shows reagent, water and output. Apothecary speed/energy upgrades apply.
book.botanicalmekanism.bionic_exoflame.0: Heats working furnaces and boosts cooking. Adding burn time costs 300 reserved mana, worth 15,000 FE by default. Cooking boosts retain the native reserve requirements.
book.botanicalmekanism.bionic_exoflame.c: Each batch needs 1,000 mB water and 16,000 FE over 160 base ticks. The bottom row shows reagent, water and output. Apothecary speed/energy upgrades apply.
book.botanicalmekanism.mechanical_apothe: Provides 16 material slots, a reagent slot and six outputs. Each batch uses 1,000 mB water. Native flowers take 100 ticks and 5,000 FE; bionic recipes set their own costs.
Fill with repeated water buckets or fluid pipes; empty buckets have their own output. Materials enter front/top/left, reagent at back, outputs at right. Native basins cannot make bionic flowers.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_bridge.title: Mana Bridge
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_bridge.0: Place beside a native pool and select its side and transfer mode. One chemical unit equals one mana, up to 1,000/t. The pool face is reserved from chemical tubes.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_charger.0: Place beside a pool. Insert one mana item and choose charge/drain plus a target percentage. It moves to output at the target. Respects item permissions; no creative pools.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_infuser.0: Handles infusion, alchemy and conjuration in 100 base ticks. Place a native catalyst in the extra slot at the back. Catalyst recipes take priority; mana costs are not discounted.
book.botanicalmekanism.runic_forge.title: Runic Forge
book.botanicalmekanism.runic_forge.0: Uses 16 slots for ingredients and recipe catalysts, plus a reagent slot. Takes 200 base ticks and native mana costs. Retained catalysts return to their slots; containers go to output.
book.botanicalmekanism.pure_converter.0: Handles solid conversions without world functions. Fluids and callback-based deepslate recipes remain with the native Pure Daisy. Base throughput matches all eight native positions working.
book.botanicalmekanism.terra_condenser.0: Place at the center of a real 3x3 terra platform: native base blocks at center/corners, lapis at the four edges. Uses native mana and 400 base ticks. A broken platform pauses work.
book.botanicalmekanism.botanical_brewery: Supply empty managlass vials, alfglass flasks or other eligible vessels at the back. Base time is 200 ticks; the vessel determines the brew and mana cost. Filled brews are not empty vessels.
book.botanicalmekanism.ore_processor.0: Insert an Orechid or Orechid Ignem and suitable stone. Uses native local weights for random ores. Ignem requires a ceiling dimension. Blocked output prevents rolls and material spending.
book.botanicalmekanism.metamorphic_stone: Transforms stone with native Marimorphosis recipes and local biome weights. Results cannot be selected. Rolls once on completion and pays the chosen mana cost.
book.botanicalmekanism.elven_trade_contr: Place beside a real portal core and select its side. Open the portal normally: it pays 200,000 mana to open and the native 500 per trade. The controller uses energy for handling.
Keep the frame, natura pylons and pools. All products enter output. An inactive portal or full output keeps materials intact. Upgrade the Lexica and process special returns at the native portal.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_enchanter_co: Place beside a formed mana enchanter, select its side, and insert equipment and enchanted books. The real device decides valid enchantments, conflicts and mana cost. Books remain.
Supply mana through native sparks or the controller. Structure damage pauses the operation; repairs resume it. Removing the controller leaves equipment in the real device, without copying it.
book.botanicalmekanism.resonance_spark_a: Native sparks of matching color supply pools and mana machines. Machine top faces must accept chemicals. Mana sparks transfer mana; Corporea sparks transfer items. These are different networks.
Install this augment at both ends to extend each-axis range from 12 to 32 blocks. Keeps native dyes, Wand controls, transfer and pool augments. Sneak-removal preserves the combined augment.
book.botanicalmekanism.corporea_orchid.0: Links ME cables with Corporea sparks. Uses one ME channel and 4 AE/t idle power, with no extra FE cable. If AE2 is absent, the block and settings remain saved.
book.botanicalmekanism.corporea_orchid.1: Put ordinary Corporea sparks on the flower and item stores. Place the master separately: its own block is not a stock node. ME terminals and Corporea devices can both access real items.
book.botanicalmekanism.corporea_orchid.2: Defaults to both directions; either direction can be disabled. The ME view excludes Corporea storage mounted by bridge flowers to avoid counting loops. One active bridge per Corporea network.
book.botanicalmekanism.corporea_orchid.3: Do not also connect the same chest through an ME storage bus; use one Corporea spark per double chest. Conflicts disable access with a reason. Offline grids, missing masters and unloaded chunks stop access.
book.botanicalmekanism.corporea_orchid.4: Items only: no fluids, mana or automatic crafting requests. Both directions share a default 2,048 items/t limit. Corporea extraction pays normal ME energy; the ME side accesses physical stores.
book.botanicalmekanism.corporea_orchid.c: Each batch needs 1,000 mB water and 36,000 FE over 240 base ticks. The bottom row shows reagent, water and output. Apothecary speed/energy upgrades apply.
Legacy Resonance Flowers remain compatible with existing networks. Recycle them into a spark augment if desired. Their model, textures and source art stay preserved for future use.
book.botanicalmekanism.resonance_bud.0: Legacy Resonance Buds keep working on existing networks and can be recycled into a spark augment. New setups use native sparks without network selection or member management.
